answer.explanation: The PS5 request rq5 for $500 was blocked and cannot be charged to grant R01GM061721. The grant is not active and not frozen: it was canceled 2026-03-10, and although a court restored it on 2026-04-20, no payment has arrived since, so spending stays frozen. The category rule also failed because entertainment is not an allowable direct cost on a federal grant, citing the NSF OIG audit of UC Davis: unallowable items charged to awards. It cannot be charged to a federal grant.
